prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: wide editorial cover for a Motion Planning Engineer career guide. Visual thesis: a route becomes meaningful only when a robot can fit through it. Create an arresting cinematic architectural scene, viewed from very low ground level diagonally into a futuristic open-air robotics proving ground. Monumental white concrete and graphite metal obstacle slabs form a challenging staggered corridor. An off-center compact unbranded autonomous rover with substantial wheels is moving around a corner; two subtly translucent future rover poses describe its intended route. A single restrained warm coral-orange route ribbon lies close to the floor, bending smoothly around the slabs with ample clearance, suggesting a planned trajectory rather than a painted road. The architecture dominates the frame; robot occupies a small but legible part of the scene. Raking daylight, long exact shadows, tactile concrete and matte composite, editorial sophistication, spatial drama. Approximately 85 percent monochrome black white gray, 15 percent deliberate coral-orange accents. No text, letters, numbers, logos, interfaces, humans, paper craft, factory, warehouse, server room, or isolated catalogue product. Landscape 16:9, high detail.
